newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil gov't to discuss CPMF tax on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil gov't to discuss CPMF tax on Friday.

text.p: Brazil's top economic policy-makers will meet on January 3 to decide whether to exempt stock market investors from a new financial transaction tax, a Finance Ministry spokesman said.
The spokesman, quoting ministry officials, said the government wanted to avoid turning investors off Brazil's stocks markets after January 23 when the new tax comes into effect.
The CPMF, as the tax is known by its Portuguese acronym, would levy a 0.2 percent charge on all financial transactions to raise about $400 million a month for Brazil's ailing health service.
The Finance Ministry spokesman said an official announcement as to the outcome of Friday's meeting may not be made until next week.
